post_catalog: select jsonb_build_object('counts',jsonb_build_object('product',(select count(*) from garimpa.product),'observations',(select count(*) from garimpa.price_observation),'publications',(select count(*) from garimpa.publication),'clicks',(select count(*) from garimpa.click_event),'short_links',(select count(*) from garimpa.short_link),'assessments',(select count(*) from garimpa.editorial_assessment)),'secret_rows',(select count(*) from garimpa.affiliate_secret),'secret_rls',(select relrowsecurity from pg_class where oid='garimpa.affiliate_secret'::regclass),'secret_policy',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)) from pg_policies p where schemaname='garimpa' and tablename='affiliate_secret'),'old_policies',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by tablename,policyname) from pg_policies p where schemaname='garimpa' and tablename<>'affiliate_secret'),'public_grants',(select count(*) from information_schema.role_table_grants where table_schema='garimpa' and table_name='affiliate_secret' and grantee in ('anon','authenticated','PUBLIC')),'resolvers',jsonb_build_object('accounts',to_regprocedure('garimpa.resolve_actor_accounts(text)') is not null,'identity',to_regprocedure('garimpa.resolve_actor_identity(text)') is not null,'device',to_regprocedure('garimpa.authenticate_extension_device(text)') is not null),'unauthorized_execution',has_function_privilege('anon','garimpa.resolve_actor_identity(text)','EXECUTE') or has_function_privilege('authenticated','garimpa.resolve_actor_accounts(text)','EXECUTE'),'role_bypassrls',(select rolbypassrls from pg_roles where rolname='garimpa_app'),'broad_rls_not_applied',to_regprocedure('garimpa.active_tenant(text)') is null,'new_commercial_surface_absent',to_regclass('garimpa.campaign') is null and to_regclass('garimpa.private_artifact') is null,'valid_memberships_resolve',(select coalesce(bool_and(exists(select 1 from garimpa.resolve_actor_accounts(u.auth_user_id) a where a.app_user_id=u.id and a.affiliate_id=m.affiliate_id)),true) from garimpa.app_user u join garimpa.affiliate_membership m on m.app_user_id=u.id and m.revoked_at is null join garimpa.affiliate_account acct on acct.id=m.affiliate_id and acct.status='active' where exists(select 1 from garimpa.app_user_role r where r.app_user_id=u.id and r.role='afiliado' and r.revoked_at is null))) as result;
runtime_no_context: begin read only; set local role garimpa_app; select current_user as runtime_role, row_security_active('garimpa.affiliate_secret') as secret_rls_active, (select count(*) from garimpa.affiliate_secret) as visible_secrets, has_table_privilege('anon','garimpa.affiliate_secret','SELECT') as anon_read, has_table_privilege('authenticated','garimpa.affiliate_secret','SELECT') as authenticated_read; commit;
runtime_house: begin read only; set local role garimpa_app; select set_config('garimpa.tenant_id','local',true), set_config('garimpa.membership_role','owner',true), set_config('garimpa.actor_type','human',true); select current_user as runtime_role, (select count(*) from garimpa.product where tenant_id='local') as house_products, (select count(*) from garimpa.publication where tenant_id='local') as house_publications, (select count(*) from garimpa.affiliate_secret) as visible_secrets; commit;
